scope: All external sources cited in the final report: existence, attribution and correspondence of stated methods/numbers. Working head a6cbc4d was edited concurrently; corrections are recorded in docs/FACT-CHECK.md.
method: Read-only primary-source browsing; bibliographic metadata, attributed methods, and quoted table numbers checked. No model/data runs or paper experiment reproduction. REPORT.md was edited concurrently by parent.

files_at_json_creation.report/REPORT.md: Editorial changes in progress; final artifact hashes are recorded separately.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [GPTRec RL — Petrov & Macdonald, 2024](https://arxiv.org/html/2403.04875v1), GenRec workshop at WWW 2024
sources.checked_claim: Teacher/student MC или BERT4Rec, затем PPO; NDCG и ILD/negative popularity. Каталоги 3416 и1000; LOO;128 validation users. Accuracy gains2.6%/.4% незначимы; Steam .0908→.0563 при popularity λ6; better trade-off vs greedy reranking в3/4 случаях. Оговорки Next-K и сравнительной причинности выше.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Table 2 (datasets); Table 3 (NDCG); §3.3 (training histories); §4.3 (split and 128 validation users); §4.4 (rewards); Appendix B (history/list separator)
sources.caveats: Next-K is not identical to local assumed-feedback rollout; source separates observed history from generated list. Cross-study objective explanation is hypothetical. Do not imply RL training on validation/test.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Session-Level Optimization — Artem Matveev et al., 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.02818v2), 5th End-to-End Customer Journey Optimization workshop at KDD2026
sources.checked_claim: Yambda5B, two-tower, off-policy REINFORCE, estimated behavior policy, multi-step importance correction; reward like+ratio/10, gamma.9. DR .6046→.6306; Recall100 .3153→.3086; feedback ratio MAE.1771. TTS only model-based, авторы это оговаривают.
sources.source_evidence_locator: §3 Recommendation as RL problem; §3.1 Behavior policy; Tables 1, 2, 3; §4.3 Test-Time Scaling
sources.caveats: Only the test-time-scaling experiment uses the same simulator for choice and evaluation; the main paper also evaluates step-IS and DR with an estimated behavior policy. Offline estimates are not real user utility.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Yambda — Alexander Ploshkin et al., 2025](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.22238v1), препринт
sources.checked_claim: GTS, замороженные состояния, сутки целей и30min gap; Listen+ threshold50%. Table6 50M ItemKNN NDCG10.0781,SASRec.0748,MostPop.0186; personalfrequency отсутствует. Локальные cohort/catalog/day и собственные метрики не сопоставимы напрямую с этой таблицей.
sources.source_evidence_locator: §4.1 Evaluation Process; §4.3 Results; Table 6 Listen+
sources.caveats: Different cohort/catalog/date and aggregation prohibit direct absolute comparison with project results; no personalfrequency row in the paper.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Yandex/Yambda commit986dce8](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/yambda/commit/986dce89ba37fee726bbaa1de30166483c5f2194)
sources.report_location: §1 paragraph Почему наши числа нельзя сравнивать; Источники
sources.checked_claim: Официальное признание ошибки NDCG aggregation, old ratio-of-sums vs mean per-user ratios, предупреждение о масштабе метрик. Полную исправность данного патча не подтверждаем: см. замечание7.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Commit message; benchmarks/yambda/evaluation/metrics.py diff, new lines 141–144 (aggregation explanation), line167 (ideal_dcg mask caveat)
sources.caveats: Patch acknowledges aggregation bug, but this exact commit calls calc_dcg(target_mask) for ideal_dcg; later corrections not audited. Prefer reports an aggregation error rather than claims fully corrected metrics.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [PPS — Davide Abbattista et al., 2024](https://arxiv.org/html/2409.04329v1), RecSys2024 LBR
sources.report_location: §2; §7 Петля повторов; §10 Другие связанные работы; Источники
sources.checked_claim: Personalized popularity smoothing epsilon.01; additive log prior дляsoftmax. Table2 NDCG10 .1745<.1826 наYandex. При больших cutoffs PPS может обгонять personalfrequency; ограничение «на NDCG10» существенно.
sources.source_evidence_locator: §2 Personalized Popularity Awareness, equations 4–7 and epsilon=0.01 paragraph; Table2
sources.caveats: Correct formula is log(1+c/0.01) up to softmax constant; Table2 baseline is0.1826, not0.1808. At larger cutoffs some PPS models beat personalfrequency.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Exp-RSFT — Keertana Chidambaram et al., 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.10279v1), препринт
sources.report_location: §3 RM audit; §5 Exp-RSFT; §10 Другие связанные работы; Источники
sources.checked_claim: Observed reward exponential-weighted SFT, без RM/propensities; item-mean comparison Table2. Stanford/Meta/Netflix affiliations подтверждены. Не приписывать универсальную слабость RM на каждом датасете, особенно Netflix; не переносить выводы между протоколами как независимое подтверждение нашего результата.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract; §3.2 equations5–7 and Observation3.1; §6 Table2 and paragraphs Benchmarking reward model training metrics
sources.caveats: Netflix Table2 RM is better than item mean on both MSE and MAE; only a general mostly-weak RM comparison is supported. Local baseline/clipping variant is an adaptation; no exact reproduction or universal theorem for this project claimed.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [AWR — Xue Bin Peng, Aviral Kumar, Grace Zhang, Sergey Levine, 2019](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.00177), препринт
sources.checked_claim: Advantage-weighted regression, value/policy supervised updates, offline reuse данных. Поддерживает родство взвешенного SFT; не доказывает эффективность локального варианта.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (advantage-weighted policy regression and offline/static datasets); arXiv author/year metadata
sources.caveats: Supports method family; no claim that the local implementation exactly reproduces AWR or inherits its empirical results.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Reward Model Ensembles — Thomas Coste et al., ICLR2024](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/dda7f9378a210c25e470e19304cce85d-Abstract-Conference.html), [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.02743)
sources.checked_claim: Conservative ensemble objectives WCO/UWO уменьшают overoptimization в BoN/PPO. Поддержана ссылка на механизм; локальный независимый seed judge не является их synthetic gold-standard RM.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (WCO/UWO, BoN/PPO); ICLR2024 proceedings metadata
sources.caveats: Source uses ensemble conservative objectives and synthetic gold reward; independent-seed project judge is not a validated true-utility oracle.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Expected Policy Gradients — Kamil Ciosek & Shimon Whiteson, AAAI2018](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.05374)
sources.checked_claim: Интегрирование по действиям для снижения дисперсии градиента. Ссылка на семейство подходов корректна; локальный exact finite-catalog objective проверяется собственным кодом, не фактом существования EPG.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (integration across actions and policy-gradient variance); arXiv comments AAAI18
sources.caveats: Citation supports expected-gradient family; exactness of local code must be checked separately.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization — Leo Gao, John Schulman, Jacob Hilton, ICML2023](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/gao23h.html), [arXiv2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10760)
sources.checked_claim: Proxy-vs-gold reward degradation при усилении оптимизации в synthetic setup, RL/BoN. Отличать механизм из статьи от доказательства настоящей пользовательской полезности в нашем judge audit.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (gold/proxy synthetic setup); PMLR ICML2023 bibliographic record
sources.caveats: Synthetic gold reward is a surrogate, not direct human ground truth; local judge disagreement is diagnostic, not proof of user harm.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [f-divergence minimization — Dongyoung Go et al., 2023](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.08215), препринт
sources.checked_claim: Alignment как divergence minimization; RLHF reverseKL и GDC forwardKL; общая f-DPG постановка. Ссылка на разные направления/divergences корректна.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (reverse/forward KL and f-DPG)
sources.caveats: Different divergence objectives are related methods, not an assertion they must close local optimization gap.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [BOND — Pier Giuseppe Sessa et al., 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.14622), препринт
sources.checked_claim: Best-of-N distribution distillation с Jeffreys divergence; это не тот же target, что Boltzmann-optimal policy. Исправление выше.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (Best-of-N target and Jeffreys divergence)
sources.caveats: Best-of-N distribution differs from the project Boltzmann/KL-optimal target.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Softmax Bottleneck — Zhilin Yang, Zihang Dai, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, William W. Cohen, ICLR2018 Oral](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.03953)
sources.checked_claim: Rank/expressivity ограничение softmax factorization. Само наличие низкоразмерного hidden state не доказывает, что именно этот механизм вызвал E1-gap; текущая оговорка «опыт не изолирует» нужна.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (rank/factorization expressivity); arXiv comments ICLR Oral2018
sources.caveats: E1 does not isolate rank bottleneck as cause; the literature supplies a possible mechanism only.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Reward Hacking — Joar Skalse et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.13085)
sources.checked_claim: Формализация расхождения imperfect proxy и true reward. Поддерживает общий термин specification/reward hacking; не даёт ground truth для нашей музыкальной utility.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (proxy-versus-true reward and unhackability definition)
sources.caveats: Formal proxy/true-reward distinction does not establish actual user utility in this project.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Duration Bias — Ruohan Zhan et al., KDD2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.06003)
sources.report_location: §6 duration bias; §10 Другие связанные работы; Источники
sources.checked_claim: D2Q: duration confounding/exposure и quantile prediction, causal adjustment. Venue дополнительно подтверждён [авторским университетским репозиторием](https://researchportal.hkust.edu.hk/en/publications/deconfounding-duration-bias-in-watch-time-prediction-for-video-re/).
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (duration confounding and D2Q); HKUST institutional publication record KDD2022 DOI10.1145/3534678.3539092
sources.caveats: Project did not implement D2Q or demonstrate causal removal of duration bias.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Counterfactual Watch Time — Haiyuan Zhao et al., KDD2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07932)
sources.checked_claim: Duration truncates latent potential watch time; causal/counterfactual likelihood model. Поддерживает связь duration bias и ограниченность простой нормировки. В проекте этот метод не реализован.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (counterfactual watch time and duration truncation); arXiv comments Accepted by KDD2024
sources.caveats: Project did not implement counterfactual watch model; duration-normalized quantiles are not equivalent.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [RLUR — Qingpeng Cai et al., The Web Conference2023 Industry Track](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.01724)
sources.checked_claim: Retention как long-term цель, accumulated inter-session intervals, Kuaishou deployment. Не выдавать за реализацию нашего next-day-return/censoring протокола.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (infinite-horizon request MDP and accumulated inter-session time); arXiv Journal reference The Web Conference2023 Industry Track
sources.caveats: Supports retention/inter-session-time RL, not a completed next-day-return implementation or a specific censoring protocol in project.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Offline Evaluation for RL-based Recommendation — Romain Deffayet et al., 2023](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.00993), препринт
sources.checked_claim: Next-item evaluation может скрывать достоинства/недостатки RL; альтернативные offline protocols. Общая связь с многошаговой оценкой поддержана.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (limitations of next-item evaluation for RL recommendation)
sources.caveats: Methodological warning, not empirical proof about project policy utility.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Widespread Flaws in Offline Evaluation — Balázs Hidasi & Ádám Tibor Czapp, RecSys2023](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14951)
sources.checked_claim: Название, авторы, venue и исследование ошибок offline recommender evaluation подтверждены. Не доказывает конкретную ошибку проекта без локальных данных/кода.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract and arXiv comments (RecSys2023); DOI10.1145/3604915.3608839
sources.caveats: Background citation; no specific numerical cross-paper claim in current text.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Adaptive Data Analysis/Holdout Reuse — Cynthia Dwork et al., 2015](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629)
sources.checked_claim: Adaptive reuse может приводить к переобучению оценке; основание оговорки о repeated selection. Не утверждает, что всякая отдельная оценка обязательно завышена.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (adaptive data analysis and reusable holdout)
sources.caveats: Adaptive reuse can bias estimates; not every individual estimate is necessarily optimistic.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [RewardBench — Nathan Lambert et al., 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13787)
sources.checked_claim: Benchmark chosen/rejected preference comparisons для reward models. Поддерживает pair-ranking как тип оценки; не переносит reliability LLM benchmark на наш RM автоматически.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract and dataset description (prompt/chosen/rejected reward-model comparisons)
sources.caveats: LLM pair-preference benchmark is methodological context, not independent validation of music RM pairaccuracy.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Stochastic Primal-Dual Decoding — Dmitrii Moor et al., Spotify, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19357v1), препринт
sources.checked_claim: Frozen underlying autoregressive model, inference-time multiobjective constrained decoding; Spotify affiliations. Нет переобучения базовой модели. Родство inference adaptation корректно, но это не тождественно нашей одношаговой Boltzmann формуле.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract and §4 Online Optimisation-Based Inference; author affiliations; §5.2 Online A/B Experiment
sources.caveats: Stochastic constrained autoregressive decoding is related to but not identical to one-step Boltzmann reweighting; no online gains transferred to project.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [OneRec — Guorui Zhou et al./OneRec Team, 2025](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.13695v4), technical report
sources.checked_claim: Kuaishou end-to-end generative recommender, reward-based post-training и online tests. В текущем тексте библиографический контекст; прямого переноса их online gains на наш проект нет.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract; §2.4 Reward System; §3.3 Post-training; §4.5 Online A/B Test
sources.caveats: Technical-report context only; industrial scale and online gains not transferred to project.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [OneRec-V2 — Guorui Zhou et al./OneRec Team, 2025](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.20900v4), technical report
sources.checked_claim: §3.1.1: user-specific log-duration buckets и percentile played_time; затем discrete advantages и GBPO. Прямая основа идеи quantile normalization; локальный reward лишь адаптация.
sources.source_evidence_locator: §3.1.1 Duration-Aware Reward Shaping: F(d)=floor(log_beta(d+epsilon)), P_u,b and percentile q; §3.1.2 GBPO
sources.caveats: Log2 is local choice of beta. Article turns percentile into top25% positives/dislike negatives and uses GBPO; continuous RM+KL reward is an adaptation.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [DPO — Rafael Rafailov et al., 2023](https://arxiv.org/html/2305.18290v3)
sources.checked_claim: Eq4/AppendixA KL-regularized optimum proportional to reference×exp(reward/beta); citation математической формулы корректна. Не означает реализацию DPO в проекте.
sources.source_evidence_locator: §4 equation4; AppendixA.1 Deriving the Optimum of the KL-Constrained Reward Maximization Objective
sources.caveats: Citation supports mathematical optimum; project does not implement DPO training.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [ARGS — Maxim Khanov, Jirayu Burapacheep, Yixuan Li, ICLR2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01694)
sources.checked_claim: Alignment через reward-guided decoding, без policy RL fine-tuning. Корректный пример inference-time adjustment.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (reward-guided search at decoding); arXiv comments ICLR2024
sources.caveats: No equivalence with complete ARGS implementation claimed.

sources.bibliographic_reference: [Controlled Decoding — Sidharth Mudgal et al., ICML2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17022)
sources.checked_claim: Frozen base LM и отдельно обучаемый prefix/value scorer, tokenwise KL-regularized control. «Без изменения весов базовой модели» верно; «вообще без обучения» было бы неверно.
sources.source_evidence_locator: Abstract (frozen base LM, learned prefix/value scorer and KL tokenwise control); arXiv comments ICML2024
sources.caveats: Base model stays frozen, but prefix scorer is trained; do not call the entire technique training-free.

additional_removed_attribution.checked_claim: Spotify uses survival modeling for future engagement and discusses right-censoring; example Premium conversion. Specific next-day-return reward was not established.

limitations: Not a reproduction of external experiments or full proof audit.
No fact checking of historical reports/research_notes outside stated scope.
Preprint existence does not establish peer review or truth of empirical claims.
Review code and local results are outside this source audit.
